suggestions.assertion: Post includes 2-3 trust signals (e.g. Licensed TACLA, Same-day, Since 2016)
suggestions.reason: The assertion says '2-3' but the post contains 5 trust signals. The assertion passes, but the wording implies a ceiling of 3 when the actual policy may allow more. Consider rewording to '2 or more trust signals' or specifying minimum count only, to avoid ambiguity about whether over-shooting is a quality concern.

No assertion checks that the post title is within the 58-character limit documented in the skill's post-formulas.md. The title 'AC Tune-Up in Katy TX — $89 Through April 30' is 46 characters and compliant, but it went unchecked — a longer title could have failed silently.

No assertion verifies the offer_expiry field is present and set to a future date relative to the post date. Offer posts without a valid expiry are a GBP policy edge case. The executor set it correctly (April 30), but this is not tested.

suggestions.assertion: Research notes are present (GSC data check was performed, weather checked)
suggestions.reason: This assertion is satisfied by any text mentioning GSC data and weather. A stronger version would require actual GSC values (impressions, positions) and a specific weather data point to appear, making it harder to satisfy with a placeholder note.

eval_feedback.overall: All 10 assertions are met with genuine evidence, not surface compliance. The skill handled self-correction well (404 CTA, character overage, em dashes caught on first draft). The eval set is solid but misses title length, offer expiry validity, and has a slightly ambiguous trust-signal count bound.
